interventions.name: Worth Decoupling Protocol
interventions.goal: Reduce shame-based avoidance by separating outcome from identity.
steps: Identify what the student fears it will prove.
Separate the result from the identity claim.

interventions.name: Small Win Protocol
steps: Define a task that can be completed in under five minutes.
Reflect on what became easier after starting.

interventions.name: Three Futures / Odyssey Planning
interventions.goal: Reduce single-path panic and generate testable future options.
steps: Plan B: pivot path if current path closes.
Plan C: wild-card path if money and judgment are removed.
Score each path for energy, alignment, resources, fear, and curiosity.

interventions.name: 20-Hour Skill Sprint
interventions.goal: Build visible beginner competence and creative confidence.

interventions.name: Intentional Authority Audit
interventions.goal: Help students identify who or what shapes their beliefs.
